newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-Lehman cuts BSkyB estimates.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Lehman cuts BSkyB estimates.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said on Tuesday it cut its profit estimates and share valuation target for British Sky Broadcasting Plc and repeated an "underperform" rating on the stock.
BSkyB shares were down 8p at 431-1/2 by 1110 GMT, near its 13-month low of 425p set on July 2.

Lehman analysts cut their 1998 and 1999 pre-tax profit estimates by some 12 percent to 317 million stg and 417 million respectively, reflecting higher distribution and marketing costs and increased competition from digital terrestrial TV.
The same underlying concerns prompted a cut in Lehman analysts' "fair value" target for BSkyB shares to 425p from 495p.

They added that other important issues remained unresolved for BSkyB, including when it will be able to sell pay-per-view soccer coverage and whether it will include soccer in its package of services to the new digital service.
